mapper.sql: id, user_id as userId, name, original_filename as originalFilename, file_size as fileSize, content_type as contentType, file_hash as fileHash, category, vector_status as vectorStatus, vector_error as vectorError, chunk_count as chunkCount, uploaded_at as uploadedAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_bases ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT, name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, original_filename VARCHAR(500), file_size BIGINT, content_type VARCHAR(100), file_hash VARCHAR(64), category VARCHAR(100), vector_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING', vector_error VARCHAR(500), chunk_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, uploaded_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_bases (user_id, name, original_filename, file_size, content_type, file_hash, category, vector_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{originalFilename}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{fileHash}, #{category}, #{vectorStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
SELECT id FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' ORDER BY category
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_bases WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND vector_status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_bases SET vector_status = #{vectorStatus}, vector_error = #{vectorError}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
